faq.title: Just Dance: Decades of Hits FAQ
faq.description: Source-checked answers about the 35-song release, launch dates, story mode and multiplayer. Checked October 14, 2026.

items.question: How many songs are in Decades of Hits?
items.answer: Ubisoft’s October 13, 2026 launch article lists 35 songs. That is the base-release list, not the total of a combined library with earlier purchases or Just Dance+.

items.question: When does the dedicated Switch 2 edition release?
items.answer: November 10, 2026, according to Ubisoft and Nintendo. Switch, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S launched October 13. Nintendo lists Switch backward compatibility on Switch 2 separately.

items.question: Do I have to finish Adventure Mode to unlock the songs?
items.answer: No. Ubisoft’s 27.0.1 patch notes state that all included songs remain accessible in the Song Library regardless of Adventure Mode progress.

items.question: How many people can dance locally?
items.answer: Up to six people. The 27.0.1 notes also confirm Adventure Mode local co-op for one to six players. Input accessories and online requirements depend on the setup.

items.question: Is this an official Ubisoft website?
items.answer: No. This is an unofficial fan guide, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft or the Just Dance rightsholders. Its sources are Ubisoft’s launch and patch articles and Nintendo’s store and launch news.

about.intro: Just Dance Decades of Hits Guide is an independent English-language reference site. Unofficial Fan Guide — Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft or the Just Dance rightsholders.

sections.heading: What this guide covers
sections.text: The 35-song official launch catalogue, platform release dates, Adventure Mode rules, multiplayer, supported control facts and library entitlements.

sections.heading: How information is checked
sections.text: We link the sources used for each page and distinguish publication, substantive modification and fact-check dates. Official Ubisoft and Nintendo material is the primary basis. Unverified reward thresholds, difficulty ratings and regional variations are not presented as fact.

sections.heading: Editorial scope
sections.text: These are researched guides, not claims of firsthand playtesting. Spelling corrections and source disagreements are explained. The launch review date is October 14, 2026; articles change only when evidence changes.

sections.heading: Corrections
sections.text: Send a source URL and the affected page in a repository issue. Please do not include personal information, account details or credentials.

privacy-policy.intro: This notice describes the current launch configuration of this static guide. Last updated October 14, 2026.

sections.heading: Accounts and submissions
sections.text: Reading the guide requires no account. The site has no login, purchase, upload, email capture or contact form. Song filtering and Pagefind searches run in your browser. Do not put personal information into URLs or search queries.

sections.heading: Cookies and browser storage
sections.text: Google Analytics 4 loads only after you accept the cookie banner. Declining keeps analytics off and does not restrict the guide. Your choice, theme preference and helpfulness feedback may be stored locally. To change your choice, clear this site's browser storage and reload; you can also remove previously set analytics cookies through browser settings. Advertisements, Cloudflare Web Analytics and third-party comments remain disabled.

sections.heading: Optional Google Analytics
sections.text: If you accept, Google Analytics uses cookies and receives page addresses and titles, visit and interaction events, referral information and browser/device information to produce traffic and engagement reports. Enhanced measurement may include scrolling, outbound links, downloads and searches encoded in page URLs. We do not intentionally send names, email addresses or account details. Google processes this data under its own policies, and data may be processed outside your country. We do not use this guide for advertising personalization.
